summary: Tested new Investments feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 4 investments endpoints (summary/holdings/sips/projection) return correct authenticated data with proper 401 on unauthenticated requests. Holdings and SIPs CRUD (POST/PATCH/DELETE) work; monthly SIP stat updates correctly on add/pause/delete. Frontend page renders all stat cards, projection chart, allocation panel, seeded 5 holdings + 3 SIPs; add/delete holding and add/pause/resume/delete SIP flows all work via UI. Regression smoke on Dashboard/Expenses/Budgets pages passes without errors.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures parent. Chart still renders correctly after layout stabilizes. Consider setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on the container to silence noisy console warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1184 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routes (auth/expenses/budgets/investments/etc.) into separate router modules for maintainability.
In /investments/sips list endpoint, start_date parsing has redundant branches (both call datetime.fromisoformat(...).date()) - simplify to a single call.
SIPUpdate.active can be set via PATCH but no PATCH for start_date/name; acceptable but document intent.
Best/worst logic sets worst=None when only 1 holding exists (worst==best would be misleading); current behavior is fine but should be documented in UI (currently handled).

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 investments+auth tests; the 15th test was an incorrect out-of-scope endpoint assumption /insights/summary and does not indicate a bug)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed_investments_demo data (5 holdings, 3 SIPs). Test-added TEST_UI_HOLD and TEST_UI_SIP were cleaned up via delete during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Investments feature is fully working. Login flow note: after login user lands on /app (not /app/dashboard); nav-dashboard also points to /app. Login button is not type=submit - use get_by_role('button', name='Log in'). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_investments.py covers auth-required, summary, projection, holdings CRUD, SIPs CRUD (with pause/resume), and regression smoke.
